reason: A read-only agent integration for searching, browsing, retrieving evidence from, and exporting citations from a local Zotero library via its local API.

summaries.zh: 通过本地 Zotero API 为 Agent 提供文献库搜索、元数据与证据段落检索、附件访问及引用导出功能。
summaries.en: A local Zotero integration that lets agents search library content, retrieve metadata and evidence passages, access attachments, and export citations.

capabilities: Read Zotero library metadata, notes, annotations, attachments, and indexed full text through a local API
Search and retrieve evidence passages from a local Zotero library
Resolve Zotero attachment paths or URLs for reading
Generate citation and bibliography text in BibTeX, BibLaTeX, RIS, and CSL JSON formats
Persist plugin configuration in the host settings file
